title: 3D纸艺作品
prompt: A 3D papercraft representation of [Subject], composed of layered paper cutouts, resting on a simple cardboard base. Highlights of [color 1] and [color 2] paper textures create depth and dimension. Set against a softly lit crafts room, realistic lighting, intricate paper edges, shallow depth of field
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro或Nano Banana Pro创作精美3D纸艺作品，通过多层剪纸和对比色彩打造立体感，适合室内装饰与车辆模型设计。在柔和灯光的手工房场景中，呈现逼真纸张纹理与精致细节，提升视觉深度。
